title: Bicycle task suite
goal: Verify steering sweep, continuous wheel rotation, and the approved powered chain-drive roundtrip for a conventional two-wheel bicycle. Superseded by task_suite.bicycle@1.1.0 (all-ACTIVE scenarios with guided ground roll); this version is retained for provenance and must not be selected for new plans.

profiles.title: Standard two-wheel bicycle
profiles.description: A steerable front assembly, continuously rotating front and rear wheels, and a two-to-one chain-driven rear output.

scenarios.title: Steering sweep
execution_requirements: Apply bounded torque to the steering rigid group and measure its continuous steering angle.
Direct actuation of the steering output is allowed by the approved task definition.
Derive the public bounded steering target directly from the selected schema-0.2 continuous_rotation_rad requirement.
Audit unintended penetration at every physical simulation time step.

scenarios.title: Continuous wheel rotation
execution_requirements: Measure continuous unwrapped accumulated wheel angle; a wrapped final pose is insufficient.
Either rotation direction is accepted by the approved task definition.
Do not mark this scenario runnable until a registered continuous-rotation program exists.
Audit unintended penetration at every physical simulation time step over the complete rotation.

scenarios.title: Powered chain-drive roundtrip
execution_requirements: Exclude initial engagement from powered rotation and ratio measurement.
Check the ratio across the powered-window samples and adjacent increments rather than endpoints alone.
Keep input actuation at zero throughout passive return.
Never actuate the rear output shaft directly.
Audit unintended penetration at every physical simulation time step.
Reject matching-sprocket overlap deeper than the chain-width-bound cap even inside fixed flexible zones.

tasks.title: Steering sweep
tasks.goal: Reach the approved steering angle and compare physical steering motion with the ideal reference.

criteria.description: The steering rigid group reaches at least 0.35 rad in either approved direction.

failure_diagnostics.description: The steering group did not reach the approved minimum angle.
The steering joint stopped before the approved sweep was reached.
The steering group detached or drifted off its authored axis.

evidence_obligations: Measure steering angle from pose_6d in both physical and ideal-reference branches.
Do not invent a return-to-home acceptance tolerance when the frozen requirement does not provide one.

tasks.title: Continuous accumulated wheel rotation
tasks.goal: Rotate a bicycle wheel through the approved unwrapped accumulated angle in either direction.

criteria.description: The wheel accumulates at least one complete unwrapped revolution in either direction.

failure_diagnostics.description: The wheel did not accumulate one complete revolution.
The trace could not establish continuous unwrapped wheel rotation.
The wheel jammed, detached, or drifted off its authored axle.

evidence_obligations: Report the continuous unwrapped accumulated wheel angle.
Execute the same commanded motion in physical and ideal-reference branches.

tasks.title: Powered chain-drive roundtrip
tasks.goal: Drive only the input shaft, verify rear output rotation and the fixed ratio, then verify passive return.

criteria.description: The powered rear output accumulates at least 2.8 rad after initial engagement is excluded.
The signed rear-output-per-input angular ratio is 2.0 within 0.02.
After input removal, the rear output returns within 0.25 rad of its start position.
The rear output is driven indirectly through the chain transmission and is never directly actuated.

failure_diagnostics.description: The rear output did not reach 2.8 rad during the powered measurement window.
The powered chain ratio was outside 2.0 plus or minus 0.02.
The rear output did not return within 0.25 rad after the input was removed.
The rear output received forbidden direct actuation.

evidence_obligations: Preserve powered-window sample and adjacent-increment ratio evidence.
Preserve the zero-input passive-return interval and complete wrench audit.
Retain physical and ideal-reference traces with per-time-step collision evidence.

source_projects.note: The fixed two-to-one chain capability is certified. Steering and generic continuous-wheel scenarios retain their approved IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED runtime status.

approval.basis: This suite groups the three previously approved bicycle tasks without changing their thresholds, runtime statuses, or joint-template bindings.
